# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components

Space and Tech Engineering LLP is an Indian drone electronics company with offices in Mumbai and Nashik. It designs and sells the Aazmuth and Exelr8 flight controllers, Skydrive AM32 ESCs and NAVSATE GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders.

We are a small team of hardware and firmware engineers making flight controllers, ESCs and GPS modules that Indian builders can actually get support for.

## Aazmuth flight controller
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/aazmuth-flight-controller.html

Aazmuth is our flagship flight controller for professional UAVs. It runs on an STM32 H7 (Cortex-M7, up to 480 MHz) and carries 3 IMUs and 2 barometers, each on its own isolated bus, so one noisy or failed sensor does not take down the flight. IMU boards plug in over 20-pin Aazmuth Bus connectors, which means you can swap or upgrade sensors without replacing the controller. Built for defence, industry, agriculture, survey, startups and universities.

Highlights:
- Triple IMU and dual barometer redundancy
- Isolated sensor buses, so vibration on one does not corrupt the others
- Modular IMU boards on the 20-pin Aazmuth Bus
- Public pinout, calibration and sensor-integration docs

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: STM32 H7, Cortex-M7
- Clock speed: Up to 480 MHz
- Memory: 2 MB flash, 1 MB RAM
- Redundancy: 3 IMUs, 2 barometers
- Size: 92 x 54 x 14.6 mm
- Weight: 63 g

Docs:
- Overview: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/overview
- Pinout: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/pinout-diagram
- Calibration: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/basic-configuration-and-calibration
- Sensors: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/sensor-integration-and-peripheral-hardware-connection
- Dimensions: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/dimensions

## Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7.html

Exelr8 is our F7 flight controller for FPV drones, made for tight, punchy racing and freestyle builds. It pairs with the Skydrive 55A AM32 4-in-1 ESC and the NAVSATE mini GPS to give you a complete Indian-designed FPV stack with local support.

Highlights:
- F7 processor
- Pairs with Skydrive 4-in-1 ESC and NAVSATE mini GPS
- Designed and supported in India

Specifications:
- Processor: F7
- Built for: FPV racing and freestyle

## Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S
Category: ESCs
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-60a.html

The Skydrive AM32 60A is a 3-6S electronic speed controller running open AM32 firmware, so you can configure and update it with the usual AM32 tools. Its 60 A rating suits heavy-lift and agriculture drones carrying sprayer payloads.

Highlights:
- 60 A rating for heavy payloads
- AM32 firmware, configurable with standard AM32 tools
- 3-6S LiPo input

Specifications:
- Current: 60 A
- Battery: 3-6S
- Firmware: AM32

## Skydrive AM32 40A 3-6S
Category: ESCs
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-am32-40a.html

The Skydrive AM32 40A is a 3-6S electronic speed controller running AM32 firmware. It is a light, efficient choice for survey, mapping and general UAV builds that do not need the 60 A headroom.

Highlights:
- 40 A rating
- AM32 firmware
- 3-6S LiPo input

Specifications:
- Current: 40 A
- Battery: 3-6S
- Firmware: AM32

## Skydrive 55A AM32 4-in-1
Category: ESCs
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/skydrive-55a-am32-4-in-1.html

The Skydrive 55A 4-in-1 puts four AM32 ESCs on a single board, which keeps wiring short and the stack tidy on 5-inch FPV builds and smaller. It is the matching ESC for the Exelr8 F7 flight controller.

Highlights:
- 4 ESCs on one board
- 55 A rating
- AM32 firmware

Specifications:
- Current: 55 A
- Type: 4-in-1
- Firmware: AM32

## NAVSATE GPS for UAVs
Category: GPS
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-gps-for-uavs.html

NAVSATE is our GPS module tuned for UAVs and tested on long flights. It gives your flight controller the position and ground-speed data it needs for position hold, return-to-home and waypoint missions, and pairs with Aazmuth for survey, agriculture and defence work.

Highlights:
- Tuned for UAVs
- Tested on long flights
- Enables position hold, return-to-home and waypoint missions

Specifications:
- Built for: UAVs
- Use: Position hold, return-to-home, waypoints

## NAVSATE mini for FPV drones
Category: GPS
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/navsate-mini-gps.html

NAVSATE mini is the compact version of our UAV GPS, made for FPV builds where weight and space matter. It adds position data for features like return-to-home to racing and long-range quads.

Highlights:
- Compact size for FPV builds
- Matches the Exelr8 FPV stack

Specifications:
- Built for: FPV drones

## Frequently asked questions
Q: What is AM32 firmware?
A: AM32 is open-source firmware for 32-bit brushless ESCs. Skydrive ESCs run it, so you can configure and update them with the usual AM32 tools.

Q: Which ESC should I buy for an agriculture or sprayer drone?
A: Start with the Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S, which is meant for heavier payloads. Share your motor, prop and battery setup and we will confirm the fit.

Q: Which flight controller should I pick?
A: Aazmuth for redundancy and professional work, Exelr8 F7 for FPV builds. Tell us your build and we will confirm.

Q: Are your drone electronics made in India?
A: They are designed in Mumbai and Nashik by our own hardware and firmware engineers, so support and fixes are a phone call away.

Q: Can I buy in bulk or for a company or OEM project?
A: Yes. Send quantity and use case through the quote form, or call or WhatsApp us, and we will reply with the right parts.

Q: Where are the pinouts and setup guides?
A: In our public documentation. Each product page links to its own docs, where they exist.

Q: Do you ship across India?
A: Call or WhatsApp us with your pincode and quantity and we will confirm shipping.

Q: When will the coming-soon products launch?
A: The TRX transmitters are on our roadmap. Message us and we will tell you as soon as there is a date.
